properties.name: entity_id
properties.description: The globally unique, system-generated surrogate identifier. Never changes over the lifetime of the entity. This is the stable join key used across every system, report, and integration that references this entity. Business keys (employee number, invoice number) may change; entity_id does not.

properties.name: agreement_type
properties.description: Classifier (EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT, VENDOR_CONTRACT, NDA, LEASE, ...).
properties.valueDefinitions:
EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT: Agreement engaging a Person as an employee.
OFFER: Pre-employment offer letter.
VENDOR_CONTRACT: Agreement with a supplier.
PURCHASE_ORDER: A specific purchase commitment.
CUSTOMER_ORDER: A specific customer purchase commitment.
LICENSE: Software or IP licensing agreement.
NDA: Non-disclosure agreement.
LEASE: Property or equipment lease.
SLA: Service-level agreement.
MSA: Master services agreement.
PARTNERSHIP: Strategic partnership agreement.
JOINT_VENTURE: Joint-venture agreement.
QUOTE: Pre-order pricing proposal.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Short human-readable title.

properties.name: reference_number
properties.description: Internal or external reference number for this agreement. Also capturable as a natural_identifier via Identifiable if multiple schemes apply.

properties.name: parties
properties.description: Two or more AgreementParty records.

properties.name: party_entity_type
properties.description: Entity type of party: one of Person, Organization, LegalEntity, OrganizationalUnit, Team. Polymorphic reference: no relationship (docs/patterns/polymorphic_references.md).

properties.name: party_entity_id
properties.description: Reference to the Person or Organization party.

properties.name: role
properties.description: Role of this party in the agreement (e.g., "buyer", "seller", "employer", "employee", "licensor", "licensee", "disclosing", "receiving").

properties.name: signed_at
properties.description: When this party signed.

properties.name: signed_by_person
properties.description: The Person who signed on behalf of this party (especially relevant when the party is an Organization).

properties.name: auto_renewal
properties.description: Whether the agreement auto-renews at effective_to.

properties.name: renewal_terms
properties.description: Free-text description of renewal terms.

properties.name: total_value
properties.refDescription: Total monetary value of the agreement, if applicable.

properties.name: governing_law
properties.description: Jurisdiction / governing law (e.g., "State of Delaware, USA").

properties.name: signed_document
properties.refDescription: Reference to the executed signed version of the agreement.

properties.name: draft_document
properties.refDescription: Reference to a draft or working version of the agreement.

properties.name: natural_identifiers
properties.description: Zero or more natural (business) keys that identify this entity. Each carries its own scheme and issuer so multiple identifier systems can coexist without conflict.

properties.name: created_at
properties.description: Timestamp when this entity record was created.

properties.name: created_by
properties.description: Actor who created this entity record. May be a user identifier, system identifier, or service account name.

properties.name: last_modified_at
properties.description: Timestamp of last modification to this entity record.

properties.name: last_modified_by
properties.description: Actor who last modified this entity record.

properties.name: lifecycle_state
properties.description: Current lifecycle state of the entity. Each entity has its own list of states, held on this attribute with the meaning of each value (D3).
properties.valueDefinitions:
DRAFT: Being drafted; not yet circulated.
IN_REVIEW: Under review by counterparties.
APPROVED: Internally approved but not yet signed.
SIGNED: All parties have signed.
EXECUTED: In force; parties are performing.
AMENDED: Amended; superseded by a newer version.
EXPIRED: Reached end of its term.
TERMINATED: Ended early by one or more parties.
ARCHIVED: Ended and archived per retention policy.

properties.name: state_effective_from
properties.description: When the current lifecycle state became effective.

properties.name: state_effective_to
properties.description: When the current lifecycle state ceases to be effective (if known).

properties.name: state_history
properties.description: Immutable history of lifecycle state transitions. Appended to on every state change; never mutated in place.

properties.name: valid_from
properties.description: Start of the real-world validity period.

properties.name: valid_to
properties.description: End of the real-world validity period (open-ended if absent).

properties.name: recorded_from
properties.description: When this record began to exist in the system.

properties.name: recorded_to
properties.description: When this record ceased to exist in the system (if superseded).

properties.name: pay_frequency
properties.description: BIWEEKLY, MONTHLY, ANNUAL.

properties.name: reason
properties.description: NEW_HIRE, ANNUAL_REVIEW, PROMOTION, MARKET_ADJUSTMENT, RETENTION.

collections.description: Total compensation structure at a point in time.

buckets.name: Compensation
buckets.description: HR subdomain Compensation. Origin of CompensationPackage.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The numeric amount (positive or negative).

properties.name: currency
properties.description: ISO 4217 currency code (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, ...). Format: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code.

properties.name: precision
properties.description: Decimal precision (digits after the decimal point). Defaults to the currency's standard minor-unit precision if omitted (typically 2 for most currencies, 0 for JPY, 3 for KWD, etc.).
A monetary amount: a decimal numeric value with its ISO 4217 currency code. Used wherever money appears in the model.
properties.name: AmountType
system_id
properties.description: Identifier of the document within its source system (URI, document ID, file path).

properties.name: source_system
properties.description: The document management system that holds this document (e.g., "sharepoint", "google-drive", "docusign-envelope").

properties.name: version
properties.description: Document version identifier.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Document status (e.g., "draft", "final", "signed", "archived"). Free-text because document status vocabularies vary widely across DMS platforms.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Human-readable document title.

properties.name: mime_type
properties.description: MIME type of the document (e.g., "application/pdf").

properties.name: url
properties.description: Direct URL to retrieve the document (if available).
A reference to a document stored in an external document management system (SharePoint, Google Drive, DocuSign, etc.).
properties.name: DocumentType
value
properties.description: The identifier value itself.

properties.name: scheme
properties.description: The naming/numbering scheme. Examples: "employee_number", "tax_id", "iso_country_code", "ein", "ssn".

properties.name: issuer
properties.description: The authority that issued this identifier. Examples: "Acme HR", "IRS", "ISO", "National Social Security Administration".

properties.name: issued_at
properties.description: When the identifier was issued (if known).

properties.name: valid_from
properties.description: When this identifier becomes effective.

properties.name: valid_to
properties.description: When this identifier ceases to be effective (for reissued keys).
A natural/business identifier value paired with the scheme that issued it and the issuer. Example: value="E10847", scheme="Acme employee number", issuer="Acme Corp HR".
properties.name: NaturalIdentifier
from_state
properties.description: The prior lifecycle state (as enum string value).

properties.name: to_state
properties.description: The new lifecycle state (as enum string value).

properties.name: transition_timestamp
properties.description: When the transition occurred.

properties.name: transitioned_by_entity_type
properties.description: Entity type of transitioned by: one of Person, Role, Team. Polymorphic reference: no relationship (docs/patterns/polymorphic_references.md).

properties.name: transitioned_by_entity_id
properties.description: The actor responsible for the transition. Typically references a Person (via their entity_id), but may be a system/service account in automated transitions.

properties.name: reason
properties.description: Free-text reason or note explaining the transition.
A single transition from one lifecycle state to another. Captured as immutable history on any Lifecycleable entity. Enables audit trails and point-in-time reconstruction of lifecycle history.
properties.name: StateTransition
